quotes.excerpt: This muscle is very important because all the power production, if this muscle cannot hold your heel.
quotes.quote: This muscle is very important because all the power production, if this muscle cannot hold your heel above the ground, then the power of the glutes and the quads, it doesn't matter.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the difficulty of maintaining shooting form in different situations
quotes.excerpt: Sometimes the ball is here, sometimes it's here, so it's harder for me to shoot in the same smoothness.
quotes.quote: Everytime the ball is in a different place. Like when I shoot catch and shoot, I get to the spot and I know the ball is coming right there. It feels so easy, but when I'm here, I feel like I got to get my feet set. Sometimes the ball is here, sometimes it's here, so it's harder for me to shoot in the same smoothness.

quotes.speaker: Drew Hanlen
quotes.summary_phrase: Drew Hanlen on his approach to adjusting to bad passes during drills
quotes.excerpt: I'm trying to move and get it set as quickly as I can. I'm always using my body.
quotes.quote: For me, pass a bad one, I'm trying to move and get it set as quickly as I can. I'm always using my body. If he passes it here, I'm not reaching and then trying to bring it back. If he passes it here, I'm moving into that shot so it's easier.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the feeling of finding peace through family
quotes.excerpt: It fills your soul up with peace. That, money cannot buy.
quotes.quote: It fills your soul up with peace. That, money cannot buy. You can be happy, right? You make a shot, you're happy. You miss a shot, you're sad. You talk to a girl, you get her number, you're happy. She says no, you're not happy. Happiness comes and goes. So, money can make you happy, but at the end of the day it won't fill you up with joy, the peace of mind. That, you can only get it from family, your mother, your father, your kids, your wife, your brothers. That's the only way.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the importance of the journey over the destination
quotes.excerpt: You know, I've been 10 years in the NBA, going to year 11. Do you know how many people I've made feel something?
quotes.quote: You know, I've been 10 years in the NBA, going to year 11. Do you know how many people I've made feel something? People won't remember. Do you know how many points I've scored in the NBA? You have to google that. But he definitely remembers when he was with his dad and how he felt that night. 5 years later, but he remembers that. That's success.
